notes: spec 2026-09-30-ledger-industry-trade-design M5: what one standing building EATS a month, in whole units of a good. A building is fed from its own manor's units of the good first (ManorEconomy.line_of nets them), then IndustrySystem buys the rest from the lord's pool of that good (goods_economy.csv pool and price_gold) at the month's end; a building the pool cannot pay for stands IDLE the next month (GameState.idle_buildings). A forge eats iron.
